meaning: only keeps (getting more/worse); continues one-directionally (usually undesirably)

exercises.example_sentence: 不況が続き、物価は上がるばかりだ。
exercises.translation: With the recession dragging on, prices only keep rising.
wrong_choice_explanations: ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 物価は上がるところだ pins the rise to a single moment before it starts, but 不況が続き describes an ongoing, one-way climb.
つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 物価は上がるつもりだ gives prices a plan of their own, which is nonsense; ばかりだ simply reports that they keep rising.
わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 物価は上がるわけにはいかない treats prices as weighing whether they may rise — meaningless for a subject like 物価.
exercises.hiragana_full: ふきょうがつづき、ぶっかはあがるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 不況の中、物価は上がり続けている。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ふきょうのなか、ぶっかはあがりつづけている。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 景気が悪く、物の値段は高くなるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: けいきがわるく、もののねだんはたかくなるばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 手を尽くしたが、祖父の病状は悪化するばかりだ。
exercises.translation: We did everything we could, but grandfather's condition only keeps deteriorating.
wrong_choice_explanations: ことにする means 'decide to' and needs a subject that can decide; 病状は悪化することにする makes grandfather's condition 'decide' to worsen, which is nonsense; ばかりだ reports a decline that keeps going despite everything.
わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 病状は悪化するわけにはいかない treats the illness as choosing whether it can worsen, which makes no sense after 手を尽くしたが.
ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 悪化するところだ places the condition just at the point of worsening, but the sentence describes a decline that keeps continuing despite all efforts.
exercises.hiragana_full: てをつくしたが、そふのびょうじょうはあっかするばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: あらゆる手を打ったが、祖父の容態は悪くなる一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: あらゆるてをうったが、そふのようだいはわるくなるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 治療を続けても、病状は悪くなるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ちりょうをつづけても、びょうじょうはわるくなるばかりだ。

vocab.meaning: to do everything possible; to exhaust

exercises.example_sentence: この村では若者の人口が減るばかりだ。
exercises.translation: In this village, the young population just keeps shrinking.
wrong_choice_explanations: つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 若者の人口が減るつもりだ gives the population an intention, which is nonsense; the sentence reports a steady, one-way shrinkage.
ようにする means 'make a point of / arrange things so that'; 人口が減るようにする would mean someone deliberately arranges the decline — not what the sentence describes, a village simply losing its young people.
ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 減るところだ places the population just on the point of shrinking, but この村では describes a decline that is already steadily under way.
exercises.hiragana_full: このむらではわかもののじんこうがへるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: この村の若者は年々少なくなっている。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: このむらのわかものはねんねんすくなくなっている。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 過疎化が進み、村の人口は減るばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: かそかがすすみ、むらのじんこうはへるばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 利息がかさみ、借金は膨らむばかりだ。
exercises.translation: With interest piling up, the debt only keeps swelling.
wrong_choice_explanations: ことにする means 'decide to' and needs a subject that can decide; 借金は膨らむことにする makes the debt 'decide' to grow, which is nonsense; 利息がかさみ explains why it keeps swelling on its own.
つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 借金は膨らむつもりだ gives the debt an intention, which is meaningless; ばかりだ reports that interest keeps making it bigger.
わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 借金は膨らむわけにはいかない treats the debt as choosing whether it may grow — meaningless for a subject like 借金.
exercises.hiragana_full: りそくがかさみ、しゃっきんはふくらむばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 利子が増えて、借金は増える一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: りしがふえて、しゃっきんはふえるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 返済が滞り、借金は膨らむばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: へんさいがとどこおり、しゃっきんはふくらむばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 会議を重ねても、事態は混乱するばかりだ。
exercises.translation: Even after repeated meetings, the situation only grows more chaotic.
wrong_choice_explanations: ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 混乱するところだ places the chaos just on the point of starting, but 会議を重ねても says it keeps worsening meeting after meeting.
ようにする means 'make a point of / arrange things so that'; 事態は混乱するようにする would mean someone deliberately makes the situation chaotic, which clashes with holding meetings to fix it.
つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 事態は混乱するつもりだ gives 'the situation' an intention, which is nonsense; the sentence reports chaos that keeps growing.
exercises.hiragana_full: かいぎをかさねても、じたいはこんらんするばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 議論を重ねるほど、事態は混乱するばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ぎろんをかさねるほど、じたいはこんらんするばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 話し合っても、状況は悪くなる一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: はなしあっても、じょうきょうはわるくなるいっぽうだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 何度も裏切られ、彼への不信感は募るばかりだ。
exercises.translation: Having been betrayed so many times, my distrust of him only deepens.
wrong_choice_explanations: わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 不信感は募るわけにはいかない treats a feeling as making a choice — meaningless; ばかりだ reports distrust that only keeps deepening.
ことにする means 'decide to' and needs a subject that can decide; 不信感は募ることにする makes the distrust 'decide' to grow, which is nonsense; repeated betrayal is what makes it deepen.
ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 募るところだ places the distrust just on the point of growing, but 何度も裏切られ describes distrust that has been building and keeps building.
exercises.hiragana_full: なんどもうらぎられ、かれへのふしんかんはつのるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 裏切りが続き、彼への不信は強まる一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: うらぎりがつづき、かれへのふしんはつよまるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 何度もだまされて、彼を信じられなくなるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: なんどもだまされて、かれをしんじられなくなるばかりだ。

vocab.meaning: to grow more intense; to mount

exercises.example_sentence: 都会に人が集まり、地方は寂れるばかりだ。
exercises.translation: As people flock to the cities, rural areas only keep declining.
wrong_choice_explanations: つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 地方は寂れるつもりだ gives rural areas an intention to decline, which is nonsense; ばかりだ reports a decline that just keeps going.
ようにする means 'make a point of / arrange things so that'; 地方は寂れるようにする would mean someone deliberately makes the countryside decline, which is not what 都会に人が集まり describes.
わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 地方は寂れるわけにはいかない treats the regions as choosing whether they may decline — meaningless here.
exercises.hiragana_full: とかいにひとがあつまり、ちほうはさびれるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 人口が都市に流れ、地方は衰える一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: じんこうがとしにながれ、ちほうはおとろえるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 若者が出ていき、地方の町は寂れるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: わかものがでていき、ちほうのまちはさびれるばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 対策が遅れ、環境問題は深刻になるばかりだ。
exercises.translation: With countermeasures lagging, environmental problems only grow more serious.
wrong_choice_explanations: ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 深刻になるところだ places the problems just on the point of becoming serious, but 対策が遅れ describes problems that keep getting worse.
ことにする means 'decide to' and needs a subject that can decide; 環境問題は深刻になることにする makes the problems 'decide' to grow serious, which is nonsense for a subject like 環境問題.
つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 環境問題は深刻になるつもりだ gives environmental problems an intention, which is meaningless; ばかりだ reports a worsening trend.
exercises.hiragana_full: たいさくがおくれ、かんきょうもんだいはしんこくになるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 手を打たなければ、環境問題は悪化する一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: てをうたなければ、かんきょうもんだいはあっかするいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 対応が遅く、環境の悪化は深刻になるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: たいおうがおそく、かんきょうのあっかはしんこくになるばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 人手不足で、残業は増えるばかりだ。
exercises.translation: Because of the labor shortage, overtime just keeps increasing.
wrong_choice_explanations: わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 残業は増えるわけにはいかない treats overtime as choosing whether it may increase — meaningless for a subject like 残業.
ところだ after the dictionary form means 'is just about to'; 増えるところだ places overtime just on the point of increasing, but 人手不足で describes an increase that keeps going.
ようにする means 'make a point of / arrange things so that'; 残業は増えるようにする would mean someone deliberately arranges more overtime, which is not what a labor shortage pushing it up describes.
exercises.hiragana_full: ひとでぶそくで、ざんぎょうはふえるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 人が足りず、残業は増える一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ひとがたりず、ざんぎょうはふえるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 忙しくなって、残業時間は延びるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: いそがしくなって、ざんぎょうじかんはのびるばかりだ。

exercises.example_sentence: 復習を怠ったせいで、成績は下がるばかりだ。
exercises.translation: Because I neglected my review, my grades only keep dropping.
wrong_choice_explanations: ことにする means 'decide to' and needs a subject that can decide; 成績は下がることにする makes the grades 'decide' to fall, which is nonsense; 復習を怠ったせいで explains why they keep dropping.
つもりだ means 'intend to' and needs a subject that can have intentions; 成績は下がるつもりだ gives the grades an intention, which is meaningless; ばかりだ reports a one-way slide caused by skipping review.
わけにはいかない means 'can't very well (do)' and needs a subject making a choice; 成績は下がるわけにはいかない treats the grades as choosing whether they may fall — meaningless after 'because I neglected my review'.
exercises.hiragana_full: ふくしゅうをおこたったせいで、せいせきはさがるばかりだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 勉強をさぼって、成績は落ちる一方だ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: べんきょうをさぼって、せいせきはおちるいっぽうだ。

audio_alternatives.kanji: 復習しないので、テストの点は下がるばかりだ。
audio_alternatives.hiragana_full: ふくしゅうしないので、てすとのてんはさがるばかりだ。

vocab.meaning: to neglect; to be remiss in
